description: Price a selection of cells right now and say whether it can be ordered (meets the minimum, not reserved, not in image review). Nothing is reserved or charged. Wraps POST /api/quote. Wall coordinates: x 0..999 (left to right), y 0..999 (top to bottom); cell index = y*1000 + x.

areas.description: One to 20 non-overlapping areas; colours are optional here.

cells.description: Individual cells, each with its own colour (instead of or in addition to rect + color): {x, y, color: "#RRGGBB"}, or the HTTP API form [idx, color] with idx = y*1000+x and color = 0xRRGGBB as an integer (e.g. [500100, 2254506] = {x: 100, y: 500, color: "#2266AA"}).

color.description: Colour of every cell in "rect", "#RRGGBB" (optional here).

rect.description: A rectangle of cells: top-left x, y and width w, height h (cells).

name: check_cells_available
title: Check cells and prices
